quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on receiving a shout-out from New York's mayor
quotes.excerpt: I did not know he was going to give me a shout-out and it was pretty cool.
quotes.quote: I did not know. I did not know he was going to give me a shout-out and it was pretty cool. I saw it kind of like everybody else saw it on Instagram or whatever, but it was pretty cool. quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on his new partnership with Milk
quotes.excerpt: I'm just getting more cognizant of my rest and my recovery and my diet.
quotes.quote: As I'm getting into year eight, I've played a lot of basketball and as I'm getting older, I'm just getting more cognizant of my rest and my recovery and my diet and the stuff I put in my body. So when this partnership with Milk came on the table, I was like this is perfect because I was already trying to just start to focus on it a little more. For me, I'm simple. My mommy used to always make me drink a glass of milk with my dinner. So that kind of is feeding into my program now. I have a glass of milk, it's nine grams of protein, so I'm able to fuel up either before or after practice or game. It's easy for me.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.excerpt: I do like more so a chicken teriyaki almost kind of vibe.
quotes.quote: I can go for sure, I can definitely tell you like game-day meals. Game-day meals, I do like more so a chicken teriyaki almost kind of vibe. I like to have rice or then pesto pasta is one of my favorite. So definitely on those game days I make sure that I eat one of those two things just to make sure that I'm fueled up and ready to go.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on the Raptors' trip to Paris
quotes.excerpt: I'm not going to say it was my idea, I will say I was one of the people.
quotes.quote: I'm not going to say it was my idea. I will say I was one of the people who put forth the idea to go there for sure. I think we were going to go somewhere else, and I was definitely on the Paris bandwagon. We had a good time, it was great. Guys like to shop, guys got to go see the Eiffel Tower and all that stuff. I used to live in France, so it was just fun for me to go there. I went there for the Olympics, so I enjoyed going to France. I speak French, very easy. But definitely was a lot of fun going there with my teammates.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on his locker room situation after being traded
quotes.excerpt: I got traded, so I kind of just took OG's locker.
quotes.quote: He don't get to pick. Well, I guess people have lockers already and stuff and then I guess if like for me I got traded, so I kind of just took OG's locker. So that's how that went. I'm sure he probably took mine over there.

quotes.speaker: RJ Barrett
quotes.summary_phrase: RJ Barrett on his relationship with Steve Nash
quotes.excerpt: Him being my godfather is good enough.
quotes.quote: No, I don't ask for anything. Him being my godfather is good enough. I think I'll count it as a birthday present as we especially last summer, we spent a week together just working out and stuff. So learning from him, that's kind of like the best present you could ever get.
